children: U.S. home essentials supplier's Q4 sales fell 2.8%, slightly missing analyst expectations
Adjusted EBITDA for Q4 rose 10.3% yr/yr, driven by improved gross margins
Company expects flat to low single digit net sales and adjusted EBITDA growth in fiscal 2027
Spectrum Brands expects fiscal 2027 net sales to be flat to up low single digits
Company sees fiscal 2027 adjusted EBITDA flat to up low single digits, excluding tariff refunds
Spectrum Brands targets ~50% conversion of adjusted EBITDA to adjusted free cash flow in fiscal 2027
HOME & GARDEN WEAKNESS - Co said Q4 sales in Home & Garden fell due to unfavorable weather and elevated retailer inventory levels, which hurt replenishment orders
MARGIN IMPROVEMENT - Gross profit and margin increased due to pricing, lower trade spend, reduced tariff rates, and cost improvement actions, partially offset by lower volume
HPC SEGMENT EFFICIENCIES - Home & Personal Care margin gains were driven by reduced tariff rates and operational efficiencies, partly offset by lower volume
*Applies to a deviation of less than 1%; not applicable for per-share numbers.
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 4 "strong buy" or "buy", 4 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the appliances, tools & housewares peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Spectrum Brands Holdings, Inc. is $100.39, about 13.7% above its November 11 closing price of $88.29
The stock recently traded at 16 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 16 three months ago
